response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced full-stack/backend engineer with strong web, mobile, and systems background, but he lacks the core requirements for this role: no significant recent C++ experience (only brief C/C++ work at National Instruments in 2014-2015), no Windows platform development, no SQL Server/Oracle experience, and no fixed income, capital markets, or investment banking domain exposure. His career has been focused on JavaScript/TypeScript, DLang, and web technologies rather than C++.
strengths: Extensive senior/staff-level software engineering experience across many domains
Strong testing, CI/CD, and software craftsmanship practices
Fluent English communicator with teaching/workshop experience
concerns: No recent or substantial C++ experience (last C/C++ work was ~10 years ago, briefly)
No Windows platform development experience evident
No fixed income, capital markets, or investment banking domain experience

key_factors.factor: No capital markets/fixed income domain experience
No SQL Server/Oracle or Windows platform experience
